business_scope.primary_industry_name: C-Suite Executive Search and Specialist Tech Headhunting

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (mainland national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax or registry subdivisions)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - statutory civil-law-oriented commercial code with Sharia principles in banking, family and personal-status matters; unitary national legislation; company registrations centralized at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP).
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 January 2009)
GCC Unified Economic Agreement (1981) and GCC Customs Union framework
Oman-Singapore double taxation avoidance agreement (DTAA, in force 2013)
Oman is a Member of ICSID, MIGA and the WTO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 Promulgating the Law on Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism, as amended by Royal Decree No. 13/2022; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 Promulgating the Commercial Companies Law (Articles 65-71 on the Single Person Company and Articles 1, 15 and 98 on the shareholders' and beneficial-owner register); Executive Regulations of the Commercial Companies Law issued by Ministerial Decision No. 100/2020; Royal Decree No. 50/2019 Promulgating the Foreign Capital Investment Law; operating instructions and UBO disclosure standards of the National Centre for Financial Information (NCFI), Oman's Financial Intelligence Unit.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Oman is a Contracting Party since 1 January 2018) OR Consular Legalization where the origin state is not a Hague member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the foreign corporate shareholder authorizing the creation of the Omani SPC and appointing the authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the origin state / corporate secretary certification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granted to the local Omani incorporation counsel for registration, name clearance and contract signing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the origin state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of the corporate shareholder's legal representative, the first director and the designated General Manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent diplomatic/consular authority of the origin state
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (with certified Arabic translation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration covering the SPC share capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the corporate shareholder

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every shareholder, director and the designated General Manager against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, UK HMT sanctions, EU CFSP designations, and Oman's domestic NCFI alert lists; enhanced due diligence on foreign PEPs, their family members and close associates (FATF Recommendation 12), including a signed PEP declaration from each UBO; continuous 24/7 sanctions re-screening at onboarding, before each retainer payment and on a rolling basis; a sanctions or PEP-match triggers immediate rejection of the name clearance and CR application plus a suspicious activity report (SAR) to the NCFI; the source of the share capital must be evidenced by the bank reference letter.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: MoCIIP Commercial Registry electronic services, known as the Commercial Registration digital portal, accessible through https://business.gov.om, with integrated one-stop filing at https://investinoman.gov.om (Invest in Oman platform); name enquiry and reservation are executed electronically before the CR application
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The legal name of the Omani SPC must be in Arabic as the required registration language; for a foreign-owned SPC, the Arabic trade name is a phonetic transliteration of the parent's corporate name, and an English name may be recorded as a secondary name only where it corresponds to the Arabic transliteration; foreign-script-only names are inadmissible and any transliteration must avoid phonetic or semantic identity with a protected mark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Oman / Royal / Sultanate / Diwan (ministerial or Royal consent required)
Bank / Insurance / Takaful / Finance (Central Bank of Oman or Financial Services Authority licence required)
Fund / Asset Management / Securities / Investment (Capital Market Authority approval required)
Oil / Gas / Petroleum (Ministry of Energy and Minerals consent required)
Islamic / Sharia (non-objection of the competent religious authority required)
General / International / Arabian / United (prior Registry authorization required)
Names identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered commercial name or trademark
Words describing an activity outside the licensed ISIC 7830 executive-search/headhunting scope
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 90 calendar days and may be renewed once at the Registrar's discretion on payment of the renewal tariff; on rejection, the applicant must file a written reconsideration request with the Director of the Commercial Registration Department, MoCIIP, within 15 working days of the refusal, proposing at least two alternative names; if the reconsideration is refused, an administrative appeal is available to the Administrative Court in Muscat within 60 days; where the refusal rests on third-party trademark priority, the applicant may also file a civil passing-off challenge; all petitions are lodged through the MoCIIP electronic petition channel and the Administrative Court filing office.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partial - the SPC must maintain a physical commercial lease in the governorate stated in the Memorandum of Association; for ISIC 7830 (executive search consultancy), MoCIIP and the municipality accept serviced offices and dedicated flexi-desks held under a registered business-centre lease; pure mailbox addresses, unlicensed virtual offices and addresses without an underlying physical lease are rejected at the CR and municipal licensing stage.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate quantified risk: approximately 15% probability of an unannounced joint municipal, Ministry of Labour and Civil Defence physical inspection within the first 12 months, rising to 40% at licence renewal, upon complaint, or where the non-Omani General Manager is apparent without a local presence; inspections verify physical occupancy, exterior signage, Civil Defence approval and the availability of the UBO register at the registered office.

Royal Oman Police - General Directorate of Civil Defence

Invest in Oman one-stop document clearance and convenience fees

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (as subsequently amended), Articles 1-8 (general incorporation formalities) and the Single Person Company chapter (Articles 246-255); Income Tax Law, Royal Decree No. 28/2009 (tax registration obligation); Labour Law Executive Regulations on private employment agencies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — Commercial Registry Department, Invest Easy one-stop shop, Sultanate of Oman.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (النظام الأساسي) filed electronically through the Invest Easy e-portal; the Commercial Registration (CR) Certificate is the conclusive instrument evidencing legal personality.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019) imposes no fixed statutory minimum share capital for an SPC; however, MoCIIP activity-classification practice for ISIC 7830 (executive search and employment services) requires a minimum declared capital of OMR 5,000 (approx. USD 13,000) subscribed in full by the sole shareholder. The amount must be deposited into a blocked/escrow corporate bank account at a licensed Omani bank, and the bank's blockage certificate is submitted with the incorporation file; the block is released upon issuance of the Commercial Registration certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the sole shareholder's subscription to 5,000 ordinary shares, each of a nominal value of OMR 1.000, aggregating OMR 5,000 (USD 13,000 approximately), is hereby ratified and recorded in the share register. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company is fixed at Building 128, Way 2417, Al Khuwair, Muscat Governorate, Sultanate of Oman. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed Chairman and Managing Director, and [Name] is appointed Compliance Officer for labour-licensing and AML obligations, each to hold office until the annual general meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the said officers are, jointly, authorized to execute all incorporation documents, open the corporate bank account, and obtain the recruitment-agency license.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Activity Pre-screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP — Invest Easy e-portal, Name Reservation Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log on to the Invest Easy portal, select the juristic-person incorporation flow, submit three proposed Arabic/transliterated names with the activity code ISIC 7830 (human resources provision and executive search), attach the shareholder's identification, and pay the name-reservation fee electronically. The reserved name is valid for 90 days and is renewable once. Ensure the name contains no prohibited or misleading words and does not conflict with existing registered marks.
required_dossiers: Copy of the sole shareholder's passport
Brief business plan and activity description aligned with ISIC 7830
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or public-order indicators, submit a fresh application with three new alternatives; alternatively, file a written objection to the Director of Commercial Registration within 15 days on legal grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Share Capital Blockage
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank authorized by the Central Bank of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate escrow account in the SPC's name using the preliminary file extract and the notarized draft Memorandum of Association; deposit OMR 5,000 (or the amount required by MoCIIP practice); obtain a bank blockage certificate addressed to MoCIIP confirming the capital remains blocked until the Commercial Registration certificate is issued; the account converts to operational status upon presentation of the CR.
required_dossiers: Preliminary file extract from Invest Easy
Passport of the shareholder and initial management
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the corporate documents, correct the signature specimens and re-submit; if the Central Bank of Oman AML review is triggered, furnish a source-of-funds declaration and certifying passport copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Legalization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Department of the Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs; Omani Embassy abroad for foreign-executed documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Arabic MoA/AoA before the Omani Notary Public; foreign shareholder signatures must be legalized at the Omani diplomatic mission in the shareholder's country of domicile and, where applicable, authenticated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. If the shareholder is non-resident, execute a notarized and legalized Power of Attorney appointing a local signatory to complete the filing.
required_dossiers: Draft Arabic MoA/AoA in four counterparts
Passport (original) of the shareholder or attorney-in-fact
Power of Attorney (consular legalized as required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary notes missing spousal consent or defective pagination, amend and re-notarize the document; for foreign instruments, re-legalize at the Omani mission and complete MFA countersignature before re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Filing and Issuance of the Commercial Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP — Commercial Registry Department, Invest Easy e-portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized MoA/AoA, blockage certificate, Power of Attorney and registered-office lease; pay the official registration and publication fees; upon approval, the CR certificate is issued electronically, conferring legal personality on the SPC and registering the supervising manager. In the same session, submit the mandatory Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) membership application.
required_dossiers: Passport plus visa/entry stamp of the shareholder or the legalized Power of Attorney
Lease agreement of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the examiner issues an inquiry/comments memo, respond through the portal within 10 business days; if the file remains unresolved for 30 days, it lapses and the applicant must re-file under a reduced 50% fee procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Income Tax and Tax Card Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the OTA e-registration using the CR number to obtain the CIF (Corporate Income File) number and the tax card; register the authorized signatories and obtain taxpayer portal credentials. The SPC is taxable on chargeable income under the Income Tax Law RD 28/2009, and intercompany transaction documentation must be prepared once related-party dealings commence.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of directors and the sole shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any mismatch between CR data and OTA records by filing a correction request; if the CR status is suspended, lift the suspension at MoCIIP and resend the OTA electronic notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Social Protection Authority (successor to the Public Authority for Social Insurance) — Employer Registration E-Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SPC as an employer under the Social Protection Law (Royal Decree No. 52/2021) through the Authority's e-services; obtain the employer registration number required for employment contracts and subsequent labour licensing; appoint the payroll contribution channel and pay the registration fees.
required_dossiers: Employment contracts of management and initial staff (or intent-to-hire undertaking)
Board resolution appointing the HR delegate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the employer file is queried for missing signatory authorization, submit the board resolution appointing the HR delegate and reissue the electronic form within the SLA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License and Civil Defence Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality — Licensing and Follow-up Department; Oman Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority (CDCAA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the municipal commercial license (Izdihar) classifying the premises as administrative/consultancy offices; obtain the CDCAA fire-safety clearance certificate covering the evacuation plan, fire extinguishers and occupancy load; the municipal license is renewable annually and must be displayed at the office.
required_dossiers: Lease contract stamped by the Municipality
Structural/occupancy load certificate from the building owner or licensed engineer
Police clearance certificate of the manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal license is refused because the premises are unfit for the activity, apply for a registered-office relocation and reissue the municipal license within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Regulated Private Employment Agency and Headhunting License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Labour — Private Employment Offices and Manpower Services Licensing Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the application for a private recruitment/employment agency license authorizing executive search and C-suite headhunting (ISIC 7830), demonstrating the manager's professional qualifications, the registered office, and the undertaking to comply with the Labour Law and the private employment agencies regulations; pay the licensing fee and obtain the annual operating license certificate.
required_dossiers: Notarized MoA/AoA expressly including recruitment and employment services as licensed purposes
Manager's curriculum vitae with academic and professional certificates
Bank guarantee or professional indemnity certificate, if imposed by the licensing decision
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Ministry issues a conditional approval, satisfy the imposed conditions within the 30-day compliance window; against a refusal, lodge an administrative objection with the Undersecretary for Labour within 15 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Labour (Sultanate of Oman) — Private Employment Offices Licensing Directorate, acting under the Oman Labour Law and the Executive Regulations on private recruitment agencies.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Private Employment Agency Operating Licence (Executive Search and Headhunting Services) — annual renewable licence authorizing the full scope of ISIC 7830 activities, including C-suite placement and specialist technology headhunting.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (He'iah Al-Bi'iah), Sultanate of Oman (successor to the Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'C' — low-impact administrative/office activity: exempt from full EIA report; only a simplified environmental self-registration (non-polluting activity declaration) is filed through the Environmental Permit e-system, with no scoping or baseline study required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC-emitting processes; office effluent discharged exclusively to the Muscat Municipality municipal sewage network; segregated municipal waste per local by-laws; e-waste (IT equipment) transferred only to Environment Authority-licensed recyclers; compliance with Omani ambient and indoor-air quality thresholds; no hazardous substances beyond standard cleaning agents covered by Material Safety Data Sheets.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: CDCAA fire-safety certification covering fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, evacuation plan and annual civil-defence inspection; municipal structural and occupancy load inspection for offices (1 person per 6 sqm occupancy standard); occupational safety clearance with a designated safety officer and first-aid provisions where the employee headcount exceeds the Labour Law threshold.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA; successor to the Secretariat General for Taxation), Muscat, Sultanate of Oman; unified e-services and filing portal 'Taxomania' at https://taxomania.gov.om; company incorporation is effected through the MOCIIP 'Invest Easy' platform.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Single Person Company (SPC) under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019) with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) via Invest Easy; the Commercial Registration (CR) is the constitutive document and precondition for tax onboarding. Step 2: Open the corporate tax file with the OTA on the Taxomania portal using the CR, Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered-office/lease evidence, and corporate bank certificate, to obtain the Tax Identification Number (TIN). Step 3: On the same portal, register for VAT when taxable supplies exceed OMR 38,500 in any 12-month period (mandatory) or OMR 19,250 (voluntary); a non-resident supplier making taxable supplies in Oman has a zero threshold and must register before commencing supply. Step 4: File the annual corporate income tax (CIT) return and prescribed VAT returns electronically; the OTA issues the tax registration card and VAT registration certificate after compliance checks, generally within 5-15 working days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not recognize check-the-box or LLC pass-through elections; the SPC is an independent juridical person taxed at entity level. The principal statutory election is the tax-group (fiscal unity) regime under the Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009), under which a resident parent holding at least 95% of the capital and voting rights of a resident subsidiary may elect consolidated filing with OTA prior approval. Other administrative elections include taxable-year alignment, depreciation policy election (straight-line over prescribed rates), loss carry-forward utilization order, and transfer-pricing method selection, all declared in the annual CIT return.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the GCC Common VAT Agreement, implemented by Royal Decree 121/2020 (Oman VAT Law) and its Executive Regulations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 38,500 of cumulative taxable supplies and taxable imports in the preceding 12 months; voluntary registration: OMR 19,250; non-resident persons supplying taxable goods or services in Oman are subject to zero registration threshold (mandatory pre-supply registration). The reverse-charge mechanism reallocates VAT liability to the Omani recipient where the supplier is non-resident.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Tax invoices and simplified invoices are statutorily required in Arabic/English and must contain all mandatory particulars (supplier and customer names and tax registration numbers, description, tax rate and amount, date, and sequential numbering). VAT returns and data are filed through Taxomania; large taxpayers are progressively required to integrate via API/ERP channels. As of the current gazetted regime, there is no fully operational real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate; however, the OTA has announced phased e-invoicing interoperability, and taxpayers should be prepared to issue machine-readable XML/EDIFACT invoices and archive them for at least the five-year statutory record period.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Executive search and headhunting services qualify for the 0% export rate when supplied to a recipient located outside Oman and outside the GCC, provided the place of benefit and actual economic enjoyment of the search work are outside the Sultanate, the invoice and written contract clearly evidence an export supply, and the supplier retains documentary proof of the client's non-residence (foreign trade register extract, foreign VAT/tax ID, or residence certificate). Where the client is a GCC taxable person, the supply generally falls within the reverse-charge mechanism of the client's state and is not subject to Omani VAT; services physically rendered inside Oman for an Omani or GCC-established customer are standard-rated at 5%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Zero-rated VAT export invoice and signed executive-search agreement naming the non-GCC client and the offshore hiring destination
Non-residency evidence of the client (foreign tax ID, trade register extract, or contractual declaration of place of establishment)
Inward Remittance Certificate / foreign-currency bank credit advice showing receipt of the fee from abroad

Delivery and benefit evidence (search work files, interview/candidate reports, placement records, and itemized expense documentation) demonstrating that the service and its economic benefit were enjoyed outside Oman
Customs export declaration or bill of lading is required only if the engagement incidentally transfers physical goods or paraphernalia, which is not typical for headhunting services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The OTA may audit export zero-rating claims for up to five tax years; if the documentation bundle is deficient, the 180-day inward-remittance benchmark is not met, or the place-of-benefit test fails, the supply is reassessed at 5% VAT with retrospective effect, and the exporter is liable for the tax, administrative violation fines under the Executive Regulations schedule (per-violation fines up to OMR 20,000, with escalation for repeat offenses), and statutory late-payment accruals on the assessed amount. Deliberate falsification of export evidence or knowledge-based under-declaration constitutes tax evasion under the VAT Law, exposing responsible persons to a criminal fine of up to OMR 20,000, imprisonment of up to three years, or both, in addition to recovery of any refund paid and automatic forfeiture of the zero-rating relief.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) is the sole licensing and supervisory authority for banking, foreign exchange, payment systems, and AML/CFT compliance. Supporting authorities include the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) for foreign-investment licensing and company incorporation, the Oman Tax Authority for tax-clearance prerequisites on outward remittances, and the National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Terrorism Financing (NCCMLTF) for national AML policy.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts and is pegged to the USD at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD. Oman imposes no exchange-control licensing requirement for foreign direct investment, dividend repatriation, or settlement of service trade; all transfers are processed through CBO-licensed banks on a documentary basis. Profit remittance by the 100% foreign-owned SPC is permitted once annual corporate tax filings are complete and the Oman Tax Authority clearance certificate is presented to the remitting bank. Omani withholding tax at 10% may apply to Oman-source payments for services, royalties, interest, and management fees made to non-resident payees where applicable; however, dividend distributions paid from after-tax profits by an Omani tax-resident entity to a non-resident shareholder are not subject to additional dividend withholding in standard practice.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman imposes no statutory surrender, mandatory conversion, or compulsory local-currency settlement regime for export proceeds. Under CBO foreign-exchange and balance-of-payments monitoring guidelines, export service receipts (including executive-search retainers and placement fees earned from overseas clients) must be repatriated into the Omani banking system through an approved correspondent channel without undue delay, credited to the SPC's operational account, and properly coded for statistical reporting. No minimum holding period or conversion ratio applies, and the SPC may retain such receipts in USD or convert to OMR at the freely available pegged rate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Provisional 'Under Incorporation' share-capital deposit account; OMR and USD operational current accounts; corporate internet banking and trade-services portal
Corporate OMR/USD current accounts; SME business banking package with payroll, trade finance, and remittance modules
Premium corporate current and USD collection accounts with dedicated cross-border FX desk and global banking connectivity to the HSBC network
Full-service corporate current account with integrated treasury, trade, and e-channel solutions for service-sector SMEs
Standard corporate operational account for small-capital service companies; ancillary remittance and payroll services
Standard corporate operational and remittance accounts; SME-focused onboarding

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility subject to strict constraints: the CBO does not license foreign electronic-money institutions (EMIs) or payment aggregators as deposit-taking banks, and Wise B2B does not possess an Omani payment-service or EMI license enabling direct OMR settlement. Wise B2B may be used only as a cross-border transmission channel for inbound client retainers in foreign currency, with final credit routed through a licensed Omani correspondent bank to the SPC's account. The SPC must disclose the aggregated-transfer structure in its KYC file, provide Wise settlement statements and underlying contracts for every received batch, and ensure that no third-party funds are commingled, otherwise the bank will treat the arrangement as unlicensed payment-service activity or a money-laundering conduit.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Although CBO regulations do not statutorily mandate an in-branch interview in every case, CBO AML/KYC guidelines require banks to apply enhanced due diligence for non-face-to-face and non-resident-UBO relationships; in practice, all major Omani banks require physical attendance of the SPC's director, beneficial owner, and authorised signatories at an account-opening meeting. Remote onboarding is not available for new corporate accounts; however, a power of attorney granted to a resident Omani manager or local agent enables ongoing account administration after the shareholder's identity has been verified in person. All corporate documents (memorandum of association, shareholders' register, board resolutions, passport copies, proof of address) must be notarised and authenticated by the Omani embassy or consulate in the shareholder's jurisdiction, and documents from apostille jurisdictions must carry the apostille with an Arabic translation where required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: A foreign individual or foreign corporate holds 100% beneficial ownership of the Omani SPC, with no local operational track record and no domestic credit history.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legalised and apostilled memorandum of association and certificate of incorporation; fully executed shareholders' register and UBO declarations; notarised passport copies of the UBO; bank and professional references from the home-jurisdiction bank; police clearance or background verification in the shareholder's jurisdiction; MOCIIP foreign-investment licence; and a detailed business plan evidencing Oman commercial substance, staffing, office premises, and projected cash flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value cross-border retainer wires from executive-search clients located in multiple foreign jurisdictions, presenting a pattern of rapid in-and-out flows inconsistent with the SPC's declared activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed master search services and retainer agreements for each client; itemised retainer and success-fee invoices cross-referenced to bank credits; client-side confirmations identifying the ultimate payor and commercial purpose; candidate placement records (offer letters, start notices); a treasury-flow narrative memorandum; and audited or internally certified financial statements evidencing true economic activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The use of the Wise B2B aggregator as the primary inbound rail, which may be interpreted as an unlicensed third-party payment settlement channel and trigger enhanced transaction monitoring.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Wise B2B corporate onboarding and licensure summary showing the relevant Wise entity and its regulatory status in its home jurisdiction; Wise settlement statements matching each inbound credit; a compliance memorandum explaining that Wise acts only as a payment transmission intermediary and not as the SPC's client; underlying client contracts; and a board resolution approving the aggregation rail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large lump-sum placement fees (i.e., one-off executive-search success fees of high average ticket size) flagged as unusual cash-flow or potential layering under CBO transaction-monitoring rules.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Contingency-retainer fee letters quantifying the fee formula; placement confirmation evidence (offer letters, signed employment agreements, start date confirmations); an approved fee schedule or tariff; candidate-to-client mapping records; invoices and settlement statements; and explanations of any multiple-currency conversions applied before crediting the SPC account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The foreign shareholder must transfer the subscribed share capital via SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's own bank account in the shareholder's name to the SPC's provisional 'under incorporation' account at the selected Omani bank, using a remittance purpose code reflecting direct investment equity contribution (e.g., capital subscription/share subscription); the remitting bank account name must exactly match the registered shareholder name, and no third-party payer is acceptable. The Omani bank issues a capital-deposit certificate upon receipt, which is presented to MOCIIP for final incorporation; following issuance of the Commercial Registration (CR), the provisional account is converted to the operational current account and the funds become available for working capital. Documentation required includes the MOCIIP name-reservation certificate, draft memorandum of association, board resolution appointing signatories, and passport copies of the directors; the Funds are then subject to normal AML ongoing monitoring.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For executive-search retainer payments, refunds to clients, and disbursements to overseas subcontractor headhunters, the standard clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 through the Omani bank's nostro network, with USD settled via CHIPS and EUR via EURO1/TARGET2, typically achieving one-to-three business day value dating. Commercial letters of credit are largely irrelevant for headhunting services and are used only when a foreign institutional client demands documentary credit; the more practical alternatives are direct MT103 transfers, trade-settlement portals offered by the Omani bank, and real-time gross settlement (RTGS) via the CBO system for same-day OMR payments to domestic recipients. Outbound profit repatriation to the foreign shareholder requires the bank to obtain the SPC's valid Oman Tax Authority clearance certificate, a board resolution authorising the dividend distribution, and audited financial statements evidencing distributable reserves; each transfer must carry the correct BOP purpose code for dividends or distributed branch profits.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OMR/USD: no hedging instrument required because the OMR is pegged to USD at a fixed 2.6008 rate and is fully convertible at the peg within Oman.
EUR/USD plain-vanilla forward contracts to fix conversion rates on recurring EUR-denominated retainer receivables.
GBP/USD plain-vanilla forward contracts for GBP-denominated placement fees and client disbursements.
Cross-currency swaps between USD and EUR or USD and GBP for long-duration executive-search agreements with fixed multi-year retainer schedules.
FX spot-swap rollover transactions to manage timing mismatches between retainer inflows and candidate-placement disbursements.

Offshore NDFs on OMR are not permissible or commercially meaningful in Oman because the fixed peg and direct convertibility eliminate the underlying exposure; any such offshore proposal should be excluded from treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Commercial Register Renewal for Single Person Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) – Invest Easy
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary date of initial commercial registration; renewal must be completed before the end of the registration year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 50–200 late-renewal fines; ongoing non-renewal is a predicate for administrative strike-off of the Commercial Registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (with Audited Financial Statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months following the end of the taxable year; 30 April for calendar-year SPCs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: OMR 100 late filing penalty, with increased charges on continued non-compliance; risk of tax registration suspension and enforced collection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of the Register of Beneficial Owners (UBO)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the Commercial Register renewal; immediate update by 15 days upon any shareholding or beneficial-owner change event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to OMR 2,000 for false or non-confirmed UBO entries; separate liability of directors and possible CR strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for every Single Person Company irrespective of turnover; a licensed auditor must be appointed by the general meeting
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB, applied consistently in the preparation of Oman statutory accounts

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: UBO details are filed in the MOCIIP electronic registry (e-Awraq) and confirmed annually as part of the CR renewal process; any share-transfer event requires an updated UBO declaration filed within 15 days, supported by copies of transfer instruments.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% on taxable income exceeding OMR 30,000; 0% on the first OMR 30,000
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None specific to executive search; small-business exemption amounts effectively lower the rate for low-margin agencies; all operating expenses and headhunting costs are deductible if properly evidenced

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Income Tax Return Form (Form CIT-1) filed through the Oman Tax Authority Electronic Portal (taxes.gov.om)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Four months after the end of the fiscal year (e.g., 30 April for calendar-year taxpayers)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer legal name and Commercial Registration (CR) number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert exact name as registered for the foreign-owned SPC and the 10-digit CR number; attach passport and CR certificate

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax Identification Number (TIN) and tax year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Omani TIN issued at Tax Authority registration; if pending, enter the temporary number and attach the preliminary registration receipt

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross executive search and consulting fees earned in Oman and abroad
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all worldwide fee income attributable to the Omani SPC; fees for overseas candidates may be sourced to the place of service if documented

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs: recruiter salaries, placement commissions, database subscriptions and candidate screening costs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support with withholding tax certificates for Oman-resident employees and invoices for third-party research providers

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative operating expenses: rent, marketing, legal fees, IT systems, travel
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident SPC must maintain expense documentation in Arabic or English; cross-border service invoices may trigger withholding tax obligations

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income (sum of Box 3 and any other income such as retainer fees, success fees, and interest)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders should reconcile this amount with transfer pricing master file revenue allocations

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and exemptions: legal deductions, tax provisions, and any treaty/CRS adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses wholly incurred in operating the Omani SPC are deductible; allocations from head office may be restricted under Article 35 of the Tax Law

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income and tax payable computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Calculate 15% on the portion of taxable income exceeding OMR 30,000; pay any resulting tax through the portal and attach proof of payment

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of OMR 10 per day up to OMR 1,000; late payment interest of 1% per month on the unpaid tax; understatement penalty of 25% of the additional tax assessed

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders unless reduced by a Double Taxation Agreement (DTA)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Non-resident shareholder must obtain a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) in its treaty jurisdiction, legalise it if required, and submit a written DTA relief application to the Oman Tax Authority before remittance of the dividend. The application must include the dividend declaration board resolution, CR/TIN of the Omani SPC, and proof of shareholding. Treaty protections may reduce the rate to 0% for shareholders holding at least 10-20% of the SPC's capital, depending on the specific DTA.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 10% (usually reduced to 5-10% under DTAs); interest: statutory 10% (often reduced to 0-10% under DTAs). All payments to non-residents are subject to compliance with the Oman withholding tax return and deposition within 14 days of the payment date.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: OMR 3,000,000 gross revenue or OMR 1,000,000 in aggregate related-party transactions; Country-by-Country Report required if group consolidated revenue exceeds OMR 30,000,000
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman's Economic Substance Regulations (RD 33/2021) apply to entities undertaking 'relevant activities', which do not include executive search or headhunting. However, the SPC must still demonstrate adequate premises, employees, and business direction in Oman to avoid characterization as a shell or conduit; general anti-avoidance provisions and the OECD substance requirements will be considered by the Tax Authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately underreporting retainer and success fees, inflating employee costs, or issuing fabricated invoices to the Oman Tax Authority to reduce taxable income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine of OMR 5,000 to OMR 50,000; full payment of evaded tax plus 25% understatement penalty and monthly interest charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or authorize false tax returns are jointly and severally liable for evaded amounts; travel bans, personal asset attachment, and imprisonment are legally available sanctions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Foreign-owned SPC with no real personnel, office, or business activity in Oman; used exclusively as a billing vehicle to pass executive search fees between foreign clients and candidates or to benefit from tax treaty claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of treaty withholding tax relief, recharacterization of fees as taxable income, imposition of 10% withholding tax, and administrative fines up to OMR 5,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally assessed for deficits if corporate assets are insufficient; disqualification from board service and personal liability for unconscionable arrangements under Omani commercial law

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting large cash retainers, anonymous cryptocurrency payments, or funding from high-risk jurisdictions without Customer Due Diligence, source-of-funds verification, or filing a Suspicious Transaction Report
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to OMR 1,000,000 under Oman AML Law (RD 30/2016); licence revocation; criminal prosecution for money laundering; freezing of bank accounts
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be arrested and personally prosecuted for money-laundering predicate offences; personal assets are subject to forfeiture, and travel bans apply during investigation

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing executive search services for regulated sectors (banking, education, state-owned entities) without the required Ministry of Labour / Ministry of Commerce licence or violating foreign placement sponsorship procedures
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines of OMR 2,000 to OMR 10,000; suspension or cancellation of the SPC trade licence; blacklisting of the company and its foreign candidates
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unpaid fines and damages to clients; egregious unlicensed placement leading to deportation matters may attract imprisonment for fraud under Omani Penal Law
